name: Checkbox
description: Lets the user turn a single option on or off, with an optional indeterminate state.

isIndeterminate.description: Shows a dash for a partially selected group, e.g. 'select all'.

isDisabled.description: Prevents interaction and dims the checkbox.

isInvalid.description: Marks the checkbox as invalid, e.g. an unaccepted required agreement.

onChange.description: Called with the new checked state.

requirements: Label is part of the click target
screenReader: Announced as a checkbox with its label and checked or not checked
Indeterminate is announced as half checked or mixed

use_when: Independent on/off options in a form
avoid_when: A setting that takes effect immediately: use Switch
Exactly one choice from a set: use RadioGroup
anti_patterns: Passing isInvalid for required or format checks (even isInvalid={false}): any defined value takes over validity and hides the built-in errors. Use isRequired and validate; pass isInvalid only for errors the app finds itself, such as from the server
